why: Duplicate of "Monsters on Vacation" (e80b7021-7f9f-4e37-84f5-dec1e40ace5f): same room, same 23 May 09:00 start, same exhibit, both live since May. "Beach Monster Exhibit" is not the exhibit's name — the museum's own announcement reads "Friendly monsters are taking their beach vacation", and a roundup listing turned that phrase into a title. This row cites womenspress.com (a press organiser page) and its ticket link is only the museum homepage; the keeper cites mcm.org's announcement, whose URL names the exhibit. It also carries the run end in end_at rather than multi_day_end, the shape that mints a new row per weekly re-find. Archived, not hidden: the exhibit is real and only the title is a paraphrase, so the lever is the one for a duplicate rather than the takedown for a fabrication.
